timecoded_text_to_speech.text: So once you've logged into your BPI portal, then what you need to do is locate the bottom option that says other services.
And so under recipients you will see Manage Recipients. So what you need to do is click Manage Recipients.
And once you've clicked that you will be driven to the page where you will enroll Billers and locate the upper right portion that says Add New Recipient.
And click that once you've clicked that you will see a drop-down menu and you will see different options.
Billers, other persons accounts, prepaid cards, prepaid phones and other prepaid merchants.
So what you want to need to select is Billers. And so this is the same procedure that I've shown in my other video about how to enroll third party Billers.
So select Billers and you are going to want to click that. And once you click Billers, then it's going to drive you to step two in which you will select the name of the Biller.
So there are a lot of Biller names here, a lot of companies listed. So make sure that you just type in the letters B, E, C, space, MC.
That's Bravo, Echo, Charlie, Space, Mama, Charlie. That's for the BPI express credit card and MC stands for MasterCard.
So MasterCards always start with the number five. So now you're going to need to have your credit card pulled out once you need to put the reference number.
Now this is the part where it gets confusing for other people. And so the reference number is the credit card number.
So once you pull out your credit card number, you need to type the 16 digit credit card number in your MasterCard.
Once you've done that, then you want to hit next. So once you click next, it's going to bring to step two where it will ask you to confirm if the details are correct.
And if it is, then you want to hit confirm and it's going to ask you for step OTP.
Okay, so it's a one time pen that's going to be sent to your mobile phone and put in the OTP that you've received.
And once you put in the OTP, hit submit and it's going to tell you that you've successfully enrolled your BPI express credit card as a Biller.

And then you want to hit done and let's start paying for this credit card. Okay, so once you hit done, then you want to select payments and load and select the account in which you would like to pay from.
Now you also want to pay for the amount in this video. We'll just put 500, then select BEC MC as the Biller and then hit next.
And then you want to confirm the amount. You'll get another OTP. And so guys, I know that this video is quite fast, but you can just, you know, backtrack the video.
And I hope that this video has helped you. And if you do, please hit the like button and for comments, suggestions, comments, or any video that you would like for me to create for you.
Put it in the comment section. And as always, subscribe to my channel for more videos like this. And I'll see you in the next video. Peace.

youtube_description:
I have received many questions in the comments section of my previous video (BPI Online - How to enroll billers online in the BPI Online system - https://youtu.be/Cq-5cDVyYoo) about how to enroll and pay their BPI MasterCard Credit Cards through the BPI web portal this 2020. In this video we show you the right way to enroll your BPI MasterCard Credit Card in the BPI web portal. This video is a guide on paying for your credit card through the internet.

I think that many people get confused on what reference number to put in when enrolling their BPI Credit Cards Online. How to locate the reference number for the BPI MasterCard Credit Card is also shown in this video. I hope that this tutorial will help you process your BPI credit card payment.

In this video, we also teach the correct way to pay the BPI MasterCard credit card - even if it is not your credit card.
